source_name: CompanyWall Македонија — профили на банки (финансиски и регистарски податоци)
why_relevant: Commercial registry aggregator with per-bank profile pages (Халкбанк, ТТК, Шпаркасе, ПК Банка). Reveals-indirectly: registry identifiers, filed accounts summaries and ownership metadata that let you tie an IR document to a legal entity. Commercial terms apply.

source_name: NBRSM — Report on financial position of the National Bank (Извештај за финансиска состојба)
why_relevant: Periodic financial statements of the central bank itself — audited accounts, balance sheet, income. Relevant for institutional/procurement-capacity intelligence rather than commercial-bank analysis.

entity_name: Mastercard / Visa market announcements for North Macedonia
source_name: IT.mk forum — fintech threads
why_relevant: Practitioner/consumer forum with sustained threads on MK fintech and payment services; surfaces user-level complaints, app problems and early rumours of launches days before media pickup.

entity_name: Google Play / App Store listings for MK payment apps
source_name: SEINet mobile app (iOS / Android push alerts)
why_relevant: Official MSE app pushing every new price-sensitive disclosure. Confirms SEI-Net has a low-latency notification channel and hints at an underlying API worth probing for structured collection.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — MK bank profiles with ownership and financials
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator carrying standardised English profiles for every MK bank including parent ownership and headline financials. Useful as a reconciliation layer and for quickly re-establishing the MK bank ↔ foreign parent mapping across the whole sector.

source_name: Република (republika.mk) — Економија
why_relevant: Broke detailed consumer-facing coverage of banks' new tariff books (bill-payment fee moving 90→120 MKD, mortgage commissions). Tariff/fee changes are exactly the payments-pricing signal rarely announced as a press release.

source_name: AppsRunTheWorld vendor customer databases (Temenos T24, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Diebold Nixdorf)
why_relevant: Aggregator of vendor-customer relationships; a cheap cross-check for which core-banking or self-service platform an MK bank runs when neither the bank nor the vendor issued a release. Coverage of small markets is thin and partly paywalled, so treat as a lead generator only.

source_name: BidDetail / TenderDetail / TenderImpulse — North Macedonia tender feeds
why_relevant: Cluster of low-cost international tender resellers indexing MK notices; individually weak but collectively useful for cross-checking whether a given bank-related RFP surfaced anywhere outside ESJN.

source_name: Chimimport AD — Financial sector: CCB AD Skopje
why_relevant: Chimimport AD (Sofia, BSE-listed) is the ultimate controlling holding above Central Cooperative Bank AD Sofia, which owns ~82.6% of Centralna Kooperativna Banka AD Skopje. Chimimport's holding-level reporting therefore contains the MK bank as a consolidated participation — a second, ultimate-owner reporting layer above the direct parent.

source_name: EEAS — EU Delegation to North Macedonia (enlargement package communications)
why_relevant: Localised EU messaging on the annual report and financial-sector reforms; often the fastest English pointer to the report and to related MK-specific EU announcements.

source_name: Erste Group — North Macedonia international desk page
why_relevant: Erste Group is the umbrella savings-bank group behind Steiermärkische; its MK desk page positions Sparkasse Bank AD Skopje within the Erste network. Erste's own IR/annual reporting does not consolidate MK as a core market, so this page marks the boundary of Erste-level MK disclosure.

source_name: eTenderi.mk
why_relevant: MK digitalisation service around tender/contract management; useful as a pointer to how private buyers and suppliers organise bid workflows outside ESJN, and possibly a notice channel.

source_name: Expres.mk — Бизнис
why_relevant: Runs computational stories off bank filings — e.g. how much domestic banks earned from fees and commissions — which is precisely the payments-revenue metric of interest and is not published in that form officially.

source_name: financialreports.eu — aggregated European issuer filings (e.g. NLB)
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator of European issuer filings; useful as an index/back-fill route to parent-group reports covering MK subsidiaries when IR sites reorganise their URLs.

source_name: FintechMK community (Fintech.mk) — Facebook page
why_relevant: The self-described first MK fintech community; social channels are where small MK payment startups actually announce launches. Platform is bot-hostile, so treat as manual/low-frequency.

source_name: Halcom - banking solutions and customer references (SI vendor active in SEE)
why_relevant: Halcom is a long-standing SEE e-banking/e-signature vendor whose regional footprint frequently includes MK subsidiaries of Slovenian groups (notably the NLB network). Its solution and reference pages are a plausible route to MK deployment facts, though no MK-named reference was confirmed in this pass.

source_name: Infomax.mk
why_relevant: Carries video/interview reactions from consumer-side commentators on bank fee increases (e.g. Krmov on 120-denar payment commissions), capturing the advocacy/complaint side of payments pricing.

source_name: J360 — North Macedonia calls for tenders, public and private contracts
why_relevant: Explicitly advertises 'public and private contracts' for North Macedonia; worth testing as a private-RFP feed.

source_name: Kurir.mk
why_relevant: General MK news site with an economy category; adds breadth for cross-checking whether a bank story is single-outlet (possible PR placement) or genuinely picked up.

source_name: Ogledalo na Vladata (Огледало на Владата) — regulations/transparency monitor
why_relevant: Civil-society monitor that indexes and critiques government regulation-making and ENER compliance. Useful as an independent pointer to regulations that were adopted with skipped consultation, and as a cross-check on official transparency claims.

source_name: Schmidt & Schmidt / Creditreform / Registrall — commercial retrieval of MK commercial-register extracts and accounting statements
why_relevant: Agency channel for obtaining certified MK register extracts and filed annual accounts without a local presence or a Macedonian digital certificate, including apostilled and translated copies. Practical fallback when ЦРРСМ's own paid services are hard to transact with from abroad; the pages also document precisely which MK filings are obtainable (extracts, annual accounts, pledges, leasing, real-estate investments).

source_name: Servisea — Јавни набавки (тендери) alerting service
why_relevant: MK commercial service that notifies companies of active tender notices matched to their activity code; a pointer to how MK suppliers discover opportunities and possibly to non-ESJN notice flows.

source_name: Skrol.mk — aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregator with an explicit economy/business stream; its dated article-index URLs suggest a browsable archive useful for backfilling what was published on a given day about banks.

source_name: TendersInfo — Macedonia government & private tenders
why_relevant: Claims to aggregate from government sites, private bodies and newspapers with daily alerts; second candidate for private-buyer RFP coverage.
